title: Weight
description: Classifies a box weight as heavier at 100 or above and heavy below 100.

data.question: Write a program that reads a weight W. Print "Box is Heavier" when W is at least 100, and "Box is Heavy" when W is below 100.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a weight W. Print "Box is Heavier" when W is at least 100, and "Box is Heavy" when W is below 100.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: The first branch catches W >= 100, so 100 prints "Box is Heavier". The W != 100 condition in the second branch is redundant.
